decisions.decision: Dispatch tier 2 as ONE serial gateway worker rather than parallel A/B workers, despite tasks.md marking A (handler/VM) and B (templates) as disjoint/parallel-ok.
decisions.why: The gateway doc pack (base + htmx-conventions + htmx-go-integration + AGENTS.md) is heavy; two parallel workers would each re-read it and drain the same 5-hour bucket concurrently. One serial worker amortizes the read and keeps a coherent view of the charges gold-standard slice. Budget is low (5h ~30%), so no time pressure forces parallelism.

decisions.decision: Treat design.md's 'confirm preset values at apply' open question as already resolved: presets 6/14/30, default 6.
decisions.why: The roadmap intention line, RM5 Decision 5 context, and tasks.md A.2 (historyDayPresets=[]int{6,14,30}, defaultHistoryDays=6) all commit to these values with the user; it is not a new decision, so autopilot proceeds without a fresh interview.
